scripts.build: cargo build -p wm-server && cd apps/wm-web && npx ng build
scripts.test:cli: cargo test -p wm-core --test cli_test && cargo test -p wm-core --test mcp_test
scripts.e2e: oxmgr apply oxfile.toml --only mock,web-e2e && sleep 8 && cd apps/wm-web-e2e && npm run test:e2e; s=$?; oxmgr stop mock web-e2e 2>/dev/null; exit $s
